title: a brief that fails several checks gets one warning line per check, in the order sections, length, language, paths, and launches, with --dry-run and without
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories": the brief checks are warnings on stderr and the launch goes on

stdout: dry run: nothing was written and Orca was not called

stderr.regex:
^jitso: warning: brief sections: missing section: Scope, Done when, Report format
jitso: warning: brief length: \d+ words, expected 40 to 800
jitso: warning: brief language: the brief must be written in English
jitso: warning: brief paths: cited path does not exist: src/ghost/x\.ts\. A file the worker will create goes on a line that starts with Output: or Creates:
$

^jitso: warning: brief sections: missing section: Scope, Done when, Report format

jitso: warning: brief language: the brief must be written in English
